gate2.verdict: PASS, three directions, both signs of the change, plus the shrink direction that a hardcoded list would fail most visibly.

constraintsHonored: Change nothing in a product repo: zero files edited in plan-review or anywhere else. This lane's only writes are its own doc_repo _inbox/ artifacts.

No rebuild, no refactor, no redeploy of the Cloud Run service -- the dispatch's conditional was evaluated against the probe and the Cloud Run service was found already correct at 100 percent on the reasoner revision.
